description: This file defines classes and objects for creating and managing socket-based authentication servers in Apache Spark, supporting communication with external processes like Python and R, with features for connection handling, authentication, and stream writing.

classes.name: SocketAuthServer
classes.description: Abstract class managing socket server creation, connection handling, and result retrieval with support for Unix domain sockets and TCP/IP.

classes.name: SocketFuncServer
classes.description: Concrete subclass of SocketAuthServer that executes a user-provided function upon socket connection.

methods.name: handleConnection
methods.description: Abstract method to process an authenticated socket connection.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Blocks until handleConnection completes and returns the result.

methods.name: serveToStream
methods.description: Creates a socket server that writes data to a stream in a background thread, returning connection info, secret, and server object.
